entities.name: Zdeněk Blatný
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdeněk Blatný is a Czech former professional ice hockey left wing who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Atlanta Thrashers and the Boston Bruins. He was drafted in the third round, 68th overall, by the Thrashers in the 1999 NHL Entry Draft.
